captions.detailed: A compact, rectangular camcorder body in matte black, featuring a prominent cylindrical lens assembly on the front. The lens assembly includes a textured outer zoom collar with raised ridges for grip and a dark circular lens element at its center. A thin, flat side display door is mounted flush on the left side of the main housing, while a small rectangular latch is located at the lower rear of the body.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact digital camcorder with a matte black rectangular body. It should feature a detailed front cylindrical lens collar with grip ridges, a flat side-folding display door, and a small rear battery-release latch, defining appropriate rotational joints for the collar, door, and latch.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a filleted Box primitive. Create the lens assembly by combining cylinders, adding grip ridges with patterned rectangular prisms, and subtracting a central cylinder for the lens aperture. Model the display door as a thin box attached via a vertical revolute joint, and model the rear latch as a small box with a revolute joint representing its pivot.
